name: Super Yamazaki
source:
[url=/c91284]Takeshi[/url]'s father.

Super Yamazaki is an energetic, cheerful person, albeit perceived as immature by others sometimes. He owns a small grocery shop in town. Has always wanted his son to become the greatest hero in history, that's why he named him "Takeshi", with "Take (武)" being "bravery", and "shi (史)" being "history".
